descriptionHtml:
Rapoo M700 Multi-Mode Wireless Mouse with Aluminum Alloy Cover

Upgrade your daily workflow, office productivity, or travel setup with the ultra-sleek and sophisticated Rapoo M700 Multi-Mode Wireless Mouse. Available at Turbo Computer, this premium peripheral seamlessly combines a modern aesthetic with advanced wireless tech, featuring a high-quality top cover crafted from durable aluminum alloy. It serves as the ultimate hardware choice for professionals, students, and laptop users across Egypt who demand a lightweight, elegant, and highly responsive pointer for smooth multitasking.

The standout feature of the Rapoo M700 is its intelligent Multi-Mode Wireless connectivity, which fully supports reliable 2.4GHz USB wireless transmission alongside Bluetooth 3.0 and Bluetooth 5.0 protocols. This enables you to pair the mouse with up to 3 separate devices simultaneously—such as your desktop PC, tablet, and smartphone—and switch between them instantly with a simple click. Boasting a high-resolution 1300 DPI optical sensor for pixel-precise navigation, near-silent click switches to maintain a quiet work environment, and exceptional power-saving battery management, it delivers the definitive modern desktop experience.
